A sequence minus itself is always empty, so the `Some(duplicate)` → `unique-field-names` refusal can never fire, and a schema with repeated field names yields a contract.   - UAT-CORE-INV, which asserts four duplicate lists are refused with unique-field-names.
  - Likely UAT-CORE-NEG "invalid field names and schema contracts are refused with a typed ContractViolation", because CoreContractsSpec lines 161-165 assert a duplicate-name contract is refused.
  - In main code, SchemaContract.from is called with distinct names (package.scala:178/187 and ErrorSink.scala:29), so I do not expect failures outside CoreContractsSpec. cdme-core is upstream of every module, though, so that is not certain.
